evidence.quote: First, while CASCADE performs robustly across a wide range of tasks, its behaviour over substantially longer horizons remains to be explored, which may involve memory growth, case management, and forgetting mechanism.

deployment-time learning requires a minimum level of foundational capability in the underlying LLM; when its zero-shot performance is near zero, learning from experience becomes substantially more challenging.
Second, the current framework primarily learns from successful experiences, discarding failed attempts that may contain informative signals.
